title: Learn how I quickly create illustration to 3d game prop assets in a matter of minutes (Solo Developer Hack)
author: Senku_Ishigami1
selftext:
So, i am working on a solo 3d adventure game and to be honest hitem3d has been (so far) real eye-opening for cranking out assets fast. here is how I roll, using this little potion bottle as an example.  
I boil that down to a phrase or two written on paper. This is my "elixir of vitality" sketch, nothing special just got the feel and shape with this.  
Then i put the sketch in hitem3ds image to 3d. In no time at all, you have a boom clean 3d prop. the mesh comes out ready to go with no fine tuning,  
next I import straight into my game engine to test scale and fit. A model looks cool by itself some times but in game it feels off.  
biggest lesson? don't overthink the first version. do it quick, test it on the fly and iterate continually. I'm no 3D pro and so this flow allows me to concentrate on building the actual game
